# Cat The Mouse Company — Free 3D Cat & Mouse Game

> Cat The Mouse Company (https://catthemouse.co) is a free, mobile-first 3D browser game about cats catching mice. The player starts as a grey tabby on a moonlit lawn and taps the mice that pop out of their holes. The core rule: never go more than 5 seconds without catching a mouse, or the round ends. Points from every round buy six more cats in the shop (orange tabby, badger, black, white, calico and the tilcayo, a real wild cat species described in 2026) and a new critter to hunt, the yellow lizard. Formerly known as "Tilcayo Cat Game".

Last updated: 2026-10-01

## The game

- Genre: arcade / reflex (whack-a-mole style). Solo mode plus a 1v1 online mode. Free, no sign-up, no install; the site shows ads. An optional 50,000-point shop pack costs US$ 3.44 and needs a Google sign-in.
- Platform: any modern web browser; designed for phones first, also works on desktop with the mouse (Space starts a round). Can be added to the home screen as a web app.
- Rules: a 3D lawn at dusk. It starts with 4 holes and a new one opens every 4.5 seconds, middle first, until all 25 are dug; a bar at the top shows when. Mice speed up smoothly (about 10% every 30 s). Tap a mouse to catch it (+1): the cat swipes its paw down on it. You start with 5 seconds; every catch adds 0.8 seconds (capped at 5) and slapping an empty hole costs 0.3 seconds. A porcupine pokes out now and then, and a green snake that stays up longer and eats any mouse that pops out right next to it. Slapping either makes the cat lick its paw and stop hunting: 2 s for the porcupine, 3 s for the snake (solo and 1v1).
- Yellow lizard (unlocked in the shop): darts out every 9–14 seconds once the lawn has 6 holes; it is quick and counts as 2 mice.
- Daily Challenge: every day has a mouse of the day, one of 100 fancy mice (10 hats × 10 accessories) that cycle every 100 days. After every 10 mice caught it appears and hops between holes. Catch 20 of it that day, across any number of rounds, to finish the challenge and add it to the album; after that it stops appearing until the next day; the full album earns the Mouse Collector seal. A cat fact (30 in all, about house cats and the tilcayo) is shown after each round. Best score is stored locally on the device.
- Power-ups pop out of holes now and then: Auto-catch (the cat catches every mouse automatically for 6 s), Full time (clock refilled to 5 s) and Freeze (for 4 s the clock stops and the whole lawn freezes: every critter, the fireflies and the cat's idle motion hold still, and each critter is wrapped in a block of ice).
- Combos: catches less than 1.5 s apart chain into a combo; callouts at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30; 10+ turns on "frenzy". An escape, an empty slap, a porcupine or a snake breaks it.
- Hunter ranks (mice caught in one round): Sleepy Kitten (0), Curious Cub (5), Lawn Prowler (12), Night Hunter (20), Shadow Stalker (30), Lawn Legend (45), Mythic Mouser (65).
- Achievement seals: eleven collectible wax seals, kept on the device — Quick Paws (30 mice in one round), Night Watch (survive 90 seconds), Clean Paws (20 catches in a round with no empty slap, porcupine or snake), Power Hoarder (collect 6 power-ups), No Escape (12 catches in a row without a mouse escaping), Lawn Duelist (win a 1v1 online match), Mouse Collector (finish all 100 daily challenges), and four streak seals for playing on consecutive days: Regular (5 days), Loyal Hunter (15), Lawn Keeper (60) and Company Legend (90).
- Sharing: after a round, "Share" copies a Wordle-style result: points, one 🐭 per mouse of the day caught out of 10, and the time. Challenge links such as https://catthemouse.co/?beat=42 show the score to beat.

## The shop

Every round adds its points to a wallet kept on the device (a 1v1 match adds 10 points per mouse caught). Each cat costs more than the one before; the chosen cat appears on the lawn and in 1v1 matches.

- Grey Tabby — free, the starting cat (silver-grey mackerel stripes, forehead "M", green eyes)
- Orange Tabby — 150,000 points
- Badger — 400,000 points (smoky coat with a white blaze down the face)
- Black Cat — 800,000 points (golden eyes)
- White Cat — 1,400,000 points (odd eyes, one blue and one gold)
- Calico — 2,200,000 points (white with orange and black patches)
- Tilcayo — 4,000,000 points (the real wild cat from Bolivia: rust coat, rosettes, two forehead stripes)
- Yellow Lizard — 600,000 points (a new critter to hunt, worth 2 mice, in solo and 1v1)

## 1v1 online (https://catthemouse.co/play)

- Two players share one 5×5 lawn. 60-second rounds, best of three, no power-ups. The first tap on a mouse wins it; the mouse of the day is worth 3; the yellow lizard is worth 2 and joins the match if either player has unlocked it; a porcupine or snake makes that player's cat lick its paw for 2 or 3 s.
- Each player's cat is the one they chose in the shop.
- Quick match pairs you with a random player; Create room gives a five-letter code to share with a friend.
- Match wins feed a global "Top cats" ranking.

## The cats (from https://catthemouse.co/about)

- Tabby is a pattern, not a breed; most tabbies have an "M" on the forehead. Breeders call grey "blue".
- About four in five orange cats are male, because the orange gene is on the X chromosome; orange cats are always tabbies.
- Calico cats are almost always female (orange and black need two X chromosomes); male calicos are usually XXY and rare.
- Smoke cats look solid but their hairs are pale at the roots.
- Black cats are considered lucky in Britain and Japan; sun can "rust" a black coat.
- Odd eyes are most common in white cats; white cats with blue eyes are often deaf.

## About the tilcayo cat (Leopardus tilcayo)

- Full name: Leopardus tilcayo Nogales-Ascarrunz, Aliaga-Rossel, Lescroart & Eizirik, 2026. Pronounced "til-KYE-oh".
- The first new wild cat species described in more than 100 years — the first since the Pampas cat in 1923.
- Described in September 2026: Lescroart et al., "Phylogenomics and museomics reveal five distinct species of tiger cats in South America", Current Biology, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2026.08.059 (https://www.cell.com/current-biology/fulltext/S0960-9822(26)01110-3).
- A tiger cat (genus Leopardus, family Felidae) native to the Bolivian Yungas cloud forest, on the eastern slopes of the Andes.
- Smaller than a domestic cat: about 45 cm (18 in) head-to-body, a tail of about 25–26.5 cm, and roughly 1.3 kg (3 lb).
- Rust-orange coat with large leopard-like rosettes, two dark stripes down the forehead, a longer and more slender tail and muted fur colour compared with the oncilla (northern tiger cat).
- Diverged from its closest tiger-cat relative around 1.4 million years ago.
- Only one individual is known: a ten-year-old male living at the Senda Verde Animal Refuge (Yungas, Bolivia), handed over by a local family around 2017. Researchers are placing camera traps across the Yungas to find wild tilcayos.
- Conservation status: not yet assessed by the IUCN.
- "Tilcayo" is the name local communities in the Yungas already used for the cat; the scientists kept it to honour that knowledge.
- Identifiers: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tilcayo · Wikidata https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141490808 · Wikispecies https://species.wikimedia.org/wiki/Leopardus_tilcayo · iNaturalist https://www.inaturalist.org/taxa/1712052

## Compared with other cat games

Full article: https://catthemouse.co/cat-games (written by the makers of Cat The Mouse Company; details from each game's page, checked 2026-09-25). All are free browser games for desktop and mobile.

- Cat The Mouse Company (catthemouse.co): arcade / reflex, tap or click, 1 player or 2 online, seven unlockable cats — best for quick score-chasing rounds and 1v1.
- Cat Simulator (Critters Studio, Poki): simulation sandbox, keyboard, 1 player — best for exploring and causing chaos.
- Kitty Loves Birds (Claudiu V, Poki): platformer, keyboard, 1 player — best classic level-by-level platforming.
- Flip Pounce (Finz Games, Poki): one-tap skill game, 1 player — best for short levels with a single input.
- Longcat (Fancade, Poki and app stores): puzzle, 1900+ levels, 1 player — best calm puzzle campaign.
- Yeetcat (Bëor Games, CrazyGames): clicker / physics launcher with upgrades, 1 player — best idle upgrade loop.

Cat The Mouse Company is a game for people, not a "game for cats" (videos/apps made for pet cats to paw at a screen).

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Cat The Mouse Company?
A: A free, mobile-first 3D browser game at https://catthemouse.co where you play as a cat catching mice. Mice pop out of holes on a lawn that grows from 4 to 25 holes; tap them to catch them. You start with 5 seconds, each catch adds 0.8 seconds (capped at 5), and the round ends when the timer hits zero. Points unlock six more cats and the yellow lizard.

Q: Which cats can I unlock?
A: Orange Tabby (150,000), Badger (400,000), Black Cat (800,000), White Cat (1,400,000), Calico (2,200,000) and Tilcayo (4,000,000). You start with the Grey Tabby.

Q: Is it the same game as Tilcayo Cat Game?
A: Yes. Tilcayo Cat Game was renamed Cat The Mouse Company on 2026-10-01 and now lives at catthemouse.co.

Q: Is the tilcayo cat real?
A: Yes. Leopardus tilcayo was formally described in September 2026 in Current Biology by an international team including Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, Jonas Lescroart and Eduardo Eizirik. It lives in the Bolivian Yungas cloud forest.

Q: What is a good score?
A: 20 mice reaches Night Hunter, 45 reaches Lawn Legend and 65 or more is the top rank, Mythic Mouser.

Q: Are there rewards for playing every day?
A: Yes: seals for 5, 15, 60 and 90 days in a row (solo rounds and 1v1 matches both count).

Q: How do I play on a computer?
A: Press Space to start and click the mice with the mouse; the lawn scales to the window.
